variety: Clear conversational Modern Standard Arabic, broadly understandable across Arab countries

delivery.brief: Native Arabic, male, 25-35, studio quality. Persona: friendly, knowledgeable technology explainer. Emotion: curious, confident, approachable. Warm mid-range voice with natural variation and crisp consonants. Deliver the opening as a genuine question, pause briefly, then explain as if speaking to one friend. Moderate pace, short pauses between ideas, clear emphasis on contrasts. Say acronyms as separate English letter names. Avoid theatrical delivery and newsreader cadence. Original voice, distinct from any reference narrator.
delivery.audioTags: Model supports inline tags. Used sparingly: [curious] on the opening question, [warmly] when the explanation starts, [short pause] after a one-word correction. Tags are not spoken.
delivery.measuredPace: Episode 01: 208 words in 102.2 s = about 122 words/min (no speed change applied).
